shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -20

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; find src -type f | head -50; echo ---; cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo ---; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && wc -l references/package-routing.md && sed -n 1,80p references/package-routing.md
grep -n "^## " references/package-routing.md | head -80
sed -n '367,385p;452,470p;312,329p' references/package-routing.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version 2>&1 | tail -2
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; for v in 7.x; do :; done; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@"^7" version peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/table@1.25.0 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 @gravity-ui/i18n @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @bem-react/classname lodash 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown" | tail -30; echo ---; grep -A30 '"dependencies"' package.json | head -30; for p in navigation table icons i18n uikit; do echo -n "$p: "; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"; done

for p in navigation table icons; do echo "== $p"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -40; done; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -120; echo; ls components hooks
cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -250

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && ls build | head -30; f=$(grep -rl "renderContent" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5); echo "$f"; grep -rn "export type AsideHeaderItem\b\|export interface AsideHeaderItem\b\|AsideHeaderItem =" build --include=*.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader && sed -n 1,200p types.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -220

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components && grep -n "RenderContentType" -A6 Content/*.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "export interface MenuItem\b" -A30 types.d.ts; grep -n "export interface LogoProps" -A12 types.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -150; ls components guides hooks
sed -n 150,400p INDEX.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build && grep -rn "ColumnReordering" docs | head -20; echo ---; grep -rln "ColumnReorderingProvider" esm --include=*.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -rn "ColumnReorderingProviderProps" -A30 esm --include=*.d.ts | head -80
sed -n 400,500p docs/INDEX.md
sed -n 500,640p docs/INDEX.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && cat components/Table/types.d.ts | head -120; echo ---; cat components/Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn "selectionColumn\|dragHandleColumn" constants/*.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -rn "export.*useTable\b" hooks/*.d.ts | head -3

grep -rln "interface BaseTableProps" . | head -2; f=$(grep -rln "interface BaseTableProps" . | head -1); sed -n 1,200p "$f" | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -160; echo ---; grep -rn "getGroupTitle\|BaseGroupHeaderProps" --include=*.d.ts . | head -8
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui && cat rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ======; cat references/icons.md | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && for n in House Gear Person Persons Receipt ShoppingCart Cart Bag; do printf "%s: " $n; grep -l "export.*\b$n\b" icons/build/esm/index.d.ts icons/build/esm/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo; done; ls icons/build/esm | head; grep -o "export { default as [A-Za-z]* }" icons/build/esm/index.js 2>/dev/null | wc -l

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"' -A3 | head -20; ls; for n in House Gear Person Persons Receipt ShoppingCart Cart Bag; do printf "%s: " $n; grep -rl "\b$n\b" --include=*.d.ts . 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && cat hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "SelectionCheckbox" components/index.d.ts components/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rln "export declare const SelectionCheckbox" --include=*.d.ts . | head -2; echo ---; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 1500; echo; grep -n "theme\|view\|size" Label/Label.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components && cat SelectionCheckbox/SelectionCheckbox.d.ts; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,40p Label/Label.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*$"; grep -n "variant\|export" Text/Text.d.ts | head -10; grep -n "export" Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components && cat BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; grep -n "getIsGroupHeaderRow" BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts; echo ---; find . -name "TreeExpandableCell*.d.ts" -exec cat {} \; | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "direction\|gap" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout -name "Flex*.d.ts" | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -n "AsideHeaderItem\|AsideHeader\b" navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts navigation/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "\"./tanstack\"" -A4 table/package.json; ls table/build/esm/tanstack* 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^tsc$|^vite$"; node -p "require('/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/typescript/package.json').version"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && grep -rln "enableColumnReordering" --include=*.d.ts . | head; echo ---; grep -rn "enableColumnReordering" --include=*.d.ts . | head -5; echo ---; cat tanstack.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "SelectionCheckbox\|RangedSelectionCheckbox" index.d.ts; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -name "Checkbox.d.ts" | head -2

sed -n 1,30p types/base.d.ts; echo ---; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@tanstack/ ; grep -rn "ColumnDefBase\|declare module" types/base.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox && cat Checkbox.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/SelectionCheckbox/SelectionCheckbox.js | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -60; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /tmp/ssr-check && /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/entry.mjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=warning --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --bundle --external:none 2>&1 | tail -20; ls /tmp/ssr-check/out 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/ssr-check && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/entry.mjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=warning 2>&1 | tail -20; cd /tmp/ssr-check/out && NODE_ENV=development node entry.mjs 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /tmp/ssr-check && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/entry.cjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=warning 2>&1 | tail -20; cd /tmp/ssr-check/out && NODE_ENV=development node entry.cjs 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -30

cd /tmp/ssr-check && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild part.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/part.mjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=error --banner:js="import {createRequire as __cr} from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && cd out && PART=nav NODE_ENV=development node part.mjs 2>/dev/null | tail -2; PART=table NODE_ENV=development node part.mjs 2>/dev/null | tail -2

cd /tmp/ssr-check/out && sed -n 115640,115655p part.mjs
cd /tmp/ssr-check/out && awk 'NR>=115648 && NR<=115760' part.mjs | grep -n "createElement\|return (\|Tooltip\|Popup\|Icon\|Portal\|Fragment" | head -40

node -e "const m=require('react-virtualized-auto-sizer'); console.log('type:',typeof m, 'keys:', Object.keys(m), 'default type:', typeof m.default, 'esModule:', m.__esModule)"; node -p "require('react-virtualized-auto-sizer/package.json').main"; grep -n "AutoSizer" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/CompositeBar/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rln "react-virtualized-auto-sizer" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm --include=*.js | head -3

cd /tmp/ssr-check && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild part.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/partb.mjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=error 2>&1 | tail -5; cd out && PART=nav node partb.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -4; PART=table node partb.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -3

cd /tmp/ssr-check && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.tsx --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"development"' --outfile=/tmp/ssr-check/out/entry-b.mjs --loader:.css=empty --log-level=error && cd out && node entry-b.mjs 2>/dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
